map_rule: For 2016-to-2018, require presidential 2016 district D/R vote totals match EXACTLY on the 2016 and 2018 congressional maps. This excludes all 18 Pennsylvania 2018 redrawn districts. For 2012-to-2014, use a source explicitly labeled 2012-14 district geometry.
limitations: Derived candidate names/votes from one secondary aggregation of MIT House results, rather than independently reconciled with the original MIT file.
2012/2014 congressional districts assumed unchanged based on the source's 2012-14 map designation; no precinct overlay audit has been completed.
2016/2018 presidential overlap check uses published 2016 D/R totals on both district vintages, rejecting every mismatched seat.
Do not use later House outcomes, contemporaneous validation targets, or 2026 results in earlier-year predictors.
Special/independent and missing-major-party ballot complications require exclusions rather than imputed two-party results.
This staging adds retrospective folds only, not 2026 historical feature values.
